To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the network structure of the organization influences the rate and direction of change in the organization's culture and performance.

(1) the organizational structure of an organization has a statistically significant impact on its corporate culture and performance, (2) the impact is positive for a centralized structure (i.e., a star network) but negative for a decentralized structure (i.e. a complete network), (3) the impact is more pronounced when the organization is small and when the organization's corporate culture is less innovative, and (4) the impact of the organizational structure is mediated by an organization's corporate cultural values.
the organizational network topology affects the evolution of corporate culture, which, in turn, influences the rate of innovation.

the following issues: (1) the impact of organizational structure on corporate culture and innovation; (2) the role of culture in innovation; (3) how to use computational models to frame empirical investigations; and (4) how computational models can facilitate the interpretation of empirical results.
the following questions: (1) What are the effects of different organizational structures on corporate culture and performance?
two questions: How does organizational structure affect corporate culture? How does culture affect performance?
